name: Shahjahanpur
registryBasis: Shahjahanpur Nagar Nigam publishes a city map page and the official district portal links government land-record services. UP’s official BhuNaksha and Bhulekh portals provide cadastral-map/land-record services, tying the municipal and state workflow to Shahjahanpur, though not establishing parcel coverage for only the urban corporation.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
technicalBlocker: The city map page is a static map; the official BhuNaksha viewer requires location and plot selection and can return land-record attributes. No district/tehsil/village/plot selection or parcel query was made because geometry-and-ID-only response fields were not verified.
scopeLimits: Evidence establishes municipal map and district land-record workflows, not city-only parcel coverage or geometry availability.
remainingUncertainty: The state viewer feature schema and urban coverage were not verified; no complete polygon sample is available.
